checks.name: Every V15 source mesh curve text and transform is retained unchanged
Replaced originals are isolated and hidden
All other source objects retain geometry materials visibility and collection links
New native architectural meshes are finite and remain above ground
Central niche and circular window are actual openings in the new masonry
Central inset wall glazing and frame parts move together into the niche
Both original clock faces remain visible in front of the new gables
Frieze medallions remain visible and concealed inherited bays receive no relief
Central turret caps have flat continuous upper surfaces and no floating old finials
Image dependencies are packed or resolve

limits: Geometry checks establish consistency and preservation, not survey accuracy.
